//: Committed defaults ONLY. Never put real credentials in this file — it is tracked by git. Real values belong in the git-ignored appsettings.Local.json, which scripts/setup.sh|ps1 generates from the repo-root .env.

ConnectionStrings.//: TradingDb gets Maximum Pool Size=40 unless it sets its own (TradingDbConnectionString): Postgres allows 100 connections in all, and on 28 Sep two overlapping APIs during a deploy took them all (53300 too many clients). Put Maximum Pool Size in the string to override it.

Logging.//: A comment inside LogLevel would be parsed as a category with an invalid level. EF Core's SQL logging is off here: every statement at Information filled logs/api.log to 2 GB in two days on the live desk. Development turns it back on.

PaperFills.//: How a live strategy's paper fill is priced (docs/modules/strategies_module.md, 'Paper fills'). A SELL fills at the bid and a BUY at the ask when the quote has them (UseBidAsk); otherwise at LTP less or plus HalfSpreadFraction (0.0015 = 0.15%). While the market is open no fill is priced from a quote older than MaxQuoteAgeSeconds; the square-offs a person or the close asks for still fill, and say so.

LotSizes.//: Fallback lot size per underlying, used when the broker master does not carry one. The MCX master never does - every commodity row reports 1 - so these are the only source for MCX and MUST match the exchange's contract specs. Verify before trading an instrument that is not already in use.

LiveFeed.//: How often the live feed hub (/hubs/livefeed) pushes prices to browsers, in ms: each connection gets at most one ReceiveTicks per interval, holding the latest price of the symbols it subscribed that changed (docs/modules/data_module.md, section 3). Never under 50.

RunPnlRetention.//: How many days of live runs' minute-by-minute P&L (run_pnl_minutes) are kept (RunPnlRetentionService). 0, the default, keeps every row: nothing is deleted that is not on Drive, and scripts/archive_to_drive.py copies each closed day (its ARCHIVE_DROP_OLDER_THAN_DAYS frees only verified days). A positive value deletes older rows in batches every 6 hours whether or not they are on Drive; only those days' intraday curves go, since a run's figures are always worked out from its positions and fills.

FeedFailover.//: Switches a silent Dhan feed to FYERS during the NSE session (FeedFailoverService). DryRun true: logs 'FEED FAILOVER (dry run) would switch' and sends one System-channel message per incident, changes nothing. Set DryRun to false (appsettings.Local.json) to let it switch, at most once a day. Enabled false turns it off entirely.

MarketIntelligence.//: Recorders for news, NSE filings, global cues and breadth (docs/modules/market_intelligence.md). All on; set one to false to switch it off. None opens a broker or feed connection. NewsScoringEnabled needs torch and transformers in the .venv (pip install -r src/AlgoTrading.PythonEngine/requirements.txt).

PatternAlerts.//: The Telegram channel candle-pattern alerts go to (docs/modules/pattern_alerts.md): trades (Telegram:ChatId, the Live Algotrading channel the trade alerts go to) or system (Telegram:SystemChatId, the Desk System channel; the trades chat while that is not set). Any case. Trades since the owner's decision of 28 Sep 2026; on 27 Sep they had gone to system. Any other value is trades, with a warning in the log and on the Pattern alerts page. Read at every send; in .env it is PatternAlerts__TelegramChannel.

IndicatorAlerts.//: Indicator alerts (config/indicator-alerts.txt) go to the channel PatternAlerts:TelegramChannel names. Set IndicatorAlerts:TelegramChannel (trades or system) only to send them somewhere else; it is left out here on purpose, since a value here would stop them following the patterns.

Frontend._comment: BaseUrl is an optional override for where the broker callback sends the browser afterwards. Unset, it returns to the origin the callback arrived on — the domain through the tunnel, localhost in development — which is always a page the API itself serves. Set it (e.g. in appsettings.Local.json) only to land on a separate dev server such as http://localhost:5173.
